concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-docs-guides-package-tracking-overview]] - 2026-09-16 unversioned website overview for adding item data at order creation and tracking after settlement for qualified physical-goods PayPal integrations, with request/response and eligibility routes; not shipment, delivery, coverage, dispute-outcome or payment-lifecycle proof
warnings: Keep the route snapshot-scoped and distinct from current GitHub package-version support or merchant/account enablement.
Preserve the post-settlement event, PayPal-branded benefit limitation, physical-goods and qualification conditions; do not broaden them to all Braintree transactions or payment methods.
A submitted or returned tracker is not proof of shipment, delivery, seller-protection coverage, dispute resolution, hold release, authorization, capture, settlement or funding.
